scope: Additional public full-text supplementary datasets screened after R3 model execution; every screened source is retained whether admitted or rejected.

inclusion_contract.required_context: human plasma or human blood plasma nanoparticle protein-corona proteomics
inclusion_contract.required_provenance: article and source supplementary assets must be public and byte-verifiable
inclusion_contract.required_analysis_unit: an explicit experimental measurement column or a defensible author-defined aggregate; no inferred non-detections
prohibited: cross-study concatenation of raw author abundance scales
treating a non-human proteome as a human-plasma validation source
using a source that fails this screen for model selection or outcome tuning

article.title: Proteomics Analysis Reveals Distinct Corona Composition on Magnetic Nanoparticles with Different Surface Coatings: Implications for Interactions with Primary Human Macrophages

quantitative_sheet.author_quantity: peptide-spectrum-match counts in CSNP1-3 and Nmag1-3 columns

decision.rationale: Although the source is human-plasma, public and quantitatively structured, it has only six measurement columns. The CSNP columns fail the predeclared minimum of 10 shared positive proteins; the three Nmag columns meet the per-batch threshold but fall far below the 12-batch external-OOD minimum. It is retained as a documented candidate and is not used in fitting, tuning or result selection.

article.title: Mapping and identification of soft corona proteins at nanoparticles and their impact on cellular association

species_audit.conclusion: The inspected quantitative proteomics worksheets are bovine-serum derived, not human plasma.

decision.rationale: A bovine-source corona experiment cannot be silently re-labelled as a human-plasma external validation source. Cross-species transfer would require a separately preregistered biological question, target and mapping policy.

article.title: Quantitative proteomics analysis of adsorbed plasma proteins classifies nanoparticles with different surface properties and size

published_scope.reported_design: six polystyrene nanoparticles by four incubation times (24 individually processed samples)
published_scope.source_evidence: The public manuscript reports 24 samples and 88 quantified proteins, but also states that these time-point samples are process replicates rather than independent biological replicates.

access_audit.official_response: Article with id PMC3252235 is not open access one

decision.rationale: A valuable study design cannot substitute for a redistributable source asset. The Europe PMC official supplementary endpoint rejects this article as non-open-access, so its spreadsheet cannot be committed, redistributed, or used to satisfy the R3 open-source evidence target without a documented licence grant from the rights holder.

screening_outcome.claim_boundary: This screening log prevents failed or incompatible full-text data sources from being hidden. It does not reduce the requirements for independent lockbox evaluation or no-author-team scientific reproduction.
